messages:
ella: Need a compact asset kit for the launch sprint — hero (1200x628), three microtiles (1080x1080), one story (1080x1920), and a small 'download demo' sticker (600x314). Include English + German. Deadline: Thu EOD.
tom: Copy that. Can we get an a/b headline for hero? also one short CTA line for sticker.
ejules: Will do A: product-first, B: value-first. Sticker CTA: "Download demo -> redwood.ai/w/demo" with UTM.
ella: Also need alt-text for each asset, plus a 1-sentence footnote: "based on internal benchmark vs baseline". Legal will review the percent claim separately.
legal-ops: Flag: any comparative language must be qualified ("up to" or "median"). Provide the exact phrasing you want translated. We'll sign off after that + method note.
designbot: Export queued id=E900 frames=[hero_AB, tile-1, tile-2, tile-3, story-1, demo-sticker] variants=[default,a11y-hc] outputs=[png:1200x628,png:1080x1080,png:1080x1920,svg]. ETA ~8m. Files will land in /figma/bench/exports/1825004321/.
frank: A11y: high-contrast variant must hit 4.5:1 for body, 7:1 for small labels. Provide static fallback for any animation.
ops: Once exports are final I can push to CDN path /assets/bench/1825004321 and to the sales drive. Confirming file naming convention: hero_A_en.png, hero_B_de.png, tile-1_a11y-en.png, etc.
tom: I'll post copy keys to the localization sheet and mark numeric strings for legal review.
ejules: Short alt-text drafts pushed to docs: https://docs.redwood/marketing/bench-alttext. Keep them <=125 chars.
legal-ops: After translations arrive we'll review within 24h. For translated number strings we need verbatim matches.
ella: Great — thanks everyone. Will wait for exports then loop legal before final upload.
